stories.title: Alaska ends controversial deal to share voter data with Justice Department
stories.summary: Lt. Gov. Nancy Dahlstrom announced her decision to terminate the agreement two weeks before she is set to leave office.

stories.summary: Also: The weekly scoreboard and a look at the action in the week ahead.

stories.title: Division of Elections certifies Alaska election results
stories.summary: The certification officially verifies Democrat Mary Peltola’s win over incumbent Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan. He has not conceded the election or publicly commented on the results.

stories.title: Peltola hires Alaskan with White House experience to lead her Senate staff
stories.summary: Sen.-elect Mary Peltola chose Raina Thiele as her chief of staff.

stories.title: Driver in crash involving Sen.-elect Peltola and her family charged with DUI
stories.summary: Democrat Mary Peltola and members of her family were treated for minor injuries following the accident in late October.

stories.title: Police apprehend RV driver involved in pursuit from Palmer to East Anchorage
stories.summary: A long stretch of the pursuit occurred on the Glenn Highway, where several people said the motor home hit their vehicles.

stories.title: With MLB sticking by salary cap, players counter that owners should just share revenues without one
stories.summary: Players have vowed never to accept a salary cap, while Commissioner Rob Manfred has said he can’t envision owners agreeing to a deal without one.

stories.title: The Southeastern Conference, in new federal court filing, is again threatening to kick LSU out
stories.summary: The lawsuit stems from LSU’s recent attempts to add football and basketball players who were recently under contract with NFL and NBA teams.
